result:
`totalCents([0.4, 0.4])` now returns 1. `totalCents` was rounding after every addition, so each 0.4 was rounded down to 0 on its own. It now adds all the amounts and calls `Math.round` once on the sum, in `src/invoice.mjs`.

I added a regression test in `test/invoice.test.mjs` for the `[0.4, 0.4]` case. It failed before the change (0 instead of 1). With the fix, `npm test` passes both tests, the new one and the existing whole-cent one.

I didn't commit anything.
